content: उपागम् €1 <ab>P.</ab> ²1 To come, approach, go or draw near (a person or place); ताभिर्नो अद्य सुमना उपागहि सहस्रापोषं सुभगे रराणा <ls>Av. 7. 48. 2</ls>. .²2 .³({%a%}) To go to, go to the state of; पञ्चत्वमुपागतः or परां तृप्तिमुपागतः; so क्रोधम्, मोहम्, क्षयम् <ab>&c.</ab> .³({%b%}) To undergo, suffer, endure. .²3 To obtain, get; दायादुपागतो दासः <ls>Mit.</ls>; <ls>Y. 2. 143</ls>. .²4 To occur, fall to the lot of. .²5 To come back, return; <ls>Ks.</ls>
